summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, confirming that proxy-related materials for an upcoming shareholder meeting were mailed on May 27, 2026. The materials include a proxy, voting instruction form, notice of meeting combined with an information circular, and a return envelope. The filing is a routine administrative notification of the mailing of meeting materials, not a special situation event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change elements. The Form 6-K is the equivalent of a U.S. 8-K for reporting a mailing confirmation, which is not a material special situation.
